title: a cancelled transcript message carried the relay preamble, markers and ledger
changelog:
### Fixed / 修复

- **A cancelled run no longer writes the relay preamble, markers or ledger into the transcript / 取消后的消息不再把转述前言、标记和台账写进对话** —
  `cancelledText` built the cancelled terminal with `relayText(report)`, and that text is appended
  to the transcript as an `assistant/message`, so the reader got the model-facing instruction
  ("Reply with those lines exactly as given… do not call any tool"), the
  `<<<GROK-WORKFLOW-REPORT>>>` markers and the internal ledger with task ids, model routes and
  deadlines — text a reader cannot use, printed right below a sentence promising that the
  technical detail lives in the progress nodes. The terminal now composes with the reader-facing
  `humanConclusion`, so the cancellation wording and the honest verified count stay and the
  instructions, markers and ledger are gone. / `cancelledText` 原来用 `relayText(report)` 组装取消
  终态，而这段文字是以 `assistant/message` 写进对话的，于是读者看到的是给模型看的指令
  （"Reply with those lines exactly as given… do not call any tool"）、`<<<GROK-WORKFLOW-REPORT>>>`
  标记，以及含任务 id、模型链路和时限的内部台账——读者用不上的东西，偏偏紧挨着一句"技术细节在
  进度节点里"。现在改用面向读者的 `humanConclusion` 组装：取消措辞与真实的核验计数照旧，指令、
  标记和台账都不再出现。

- **A cancelled report with no task rows says nothing had started instead of `0/0` / 取消时没有任务行的报告直接说没开工，不再写 `0/0`** —
  a plan or deadline failure keeps a report with `tasks: []`, so the line read
  `取消前已有 0/0 项任务核验通过`: a fraction nobody can parse, which also reads as "nothing
  passed verification" instead of "nothing was ever started". That case now says so in words. /
  计划阶段或超时失败留下的报告是 `tasks: []`，原来的句子写成 `取消前已有 0/0 项任务核验通过`——既没
  法读，又会被理解成"一项都没通过核验"，而不是"一项都还没开工"。这种情况现在用文字说明。

### Tests / 测试

- `test/gate-partial-head.spec.ts` (14): the cancelled message must carry no relay preamble, no
  `REPORT_BEGIN`/`REPORT_END`, no `LEDGER_GUARD` and no ledger line, and a kept report with no task
  rows must drop the `0/0` fraction and say nothing had started; red before the fix
  (2 failed / 12 passed, `expected '…' not to contain '0/0'`).
- `test/phase1-dialogue.spec.ts`: the cancelled-transcript case pinned `PARTIAL`, `Task b` and
  `not started` — the ledger this fix removes. It now pins the reader-facing equivalents (the
  `1/2` count line, `做成的：Task a`, `没做成的：`, the stopped-task reason) plus the absence of the
  markers and the relay preamble.
report:
## Round 11 — a cancelled transcript message carried the relay preamble, markers and ledger

- **Theme (P0, wrong output a reader sees):** `cancelledText` (`src/gate.ts`) built the cancelled
  terminal with `relayText(report, undefined, …)`, and `commitCancelled` appends that text to the
  transcript as an `assistant/message` (`session.append('assistant/message', …)`). The reader
  therefore got the model-facing preamble (`SUCCESS_PREAMBLE`/`FAILURE_PREAMBLE`: "Reply with those
  lines exactly as given… do not call any tool"), the `<<<GROK-WORKFLOW-REPORT>>>` markers,
  `LEDGER_GUARD` and the whole machine ledger — task ids, model routes, deadline — in the same
  message that tells the reader the technical detail lives in the progress nodes. A second, smaller
  defect in the same function: the `取消前已有 N/M 项任务核验通过` line printed `0/0` when the kept
  report had no task rows (a plan or deadline failure report carries `tasks: []`).
- **Change:** the cancelled terminal composes with `humanConclusion` (`src/delivery/index.ts`), the
  same reader-facing composer `humanHead` uses — no preamble, no markers, no ledger. Cancellation
  wording and the verified fraction are kept; the no-task-rows case says nothing had started
  instead of `0/0`. The doc comment now states why `relayText` must not be used on a transcript
  message.
- **Files:** `src/gate.ts`, `test/gate-partial-head.spec.ts`, `test/phase1-dialogue.spec.ts`,
  `.rsi/evidence/round-011/`.
- **Evidence:** `.rsi/evidence/round-011/red.txt` (2 failed / 12 passed: relay preamble,
  `REPORT_BEGIN` and `LEDGER_GUARD` present; `0/0` present),
  `.rsi/evidence/round-011/green.txt` (14/14 pass),
  `.rsi/evidence/round-011/suite.txt` (full suite 54 files / 983 tests passed),
  `.rsi/evidence/round-011/git.txt` (commands and counts).
- **CI:** {{CI}}
- **Tag:** {{TAG}}
- **Unverified:** `npm run ci` as a single command is `NOT_RUN` — its `build` step rewrites
  `lib/`, which this round must not touch; `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` (exit 0),
  `npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit` (exit 0), `npx oxlint src test` (0 errors / 21
  warnings; `origin/main` 22 — the removed one is the redundant spread this fix deleted) and
  `npx vitest run` were run instead. No live DSH profile run (`NOT_RUN`): the change is string
  composition covered offline. One existing assertion was replaced, not weakened:
  `test/phase1-dialogue.spec.ts` pinned `PARTIAL` / `Task b` / `not started`, i.e. exactly the
  ledger lines this round removes, and now pins the reader-facing equivalents plus the absence of
  the markers and preamble.
- **Suggested version:** patch → `0.11.11`.
- **status:** OK
